div.div:
Notes
*1 Container migration is a branch from stage 1 onward
Not measured here. No arrow is drawn from
the branch to the volume
*2 AIMF is the main line of stage 2
AIMF Phase 0a took in the atx analysis. The atx
dotnet-modernization transformation was run separately,
as a comparison
*3 The access path changes; the volume does not
SMB from stage 0 still works in stage 1. Stage 2
mounted over cifs as well as NFS. The stage 3 Lambda
function reads and writes the same volume through S3
Access Points
